items.item: DDU Digital Design Unit, TU Darmstadt

Fetches the original (as uploaded, full fidelity) snapshot geometry as binary PLY from the CSC API, with ETag caching. Input can be: - Geometry carrying the 'csc_component' user text - A component passport JSON string ({identity, snapshots[]}) - A raw identity_id (resolves the current snapshot) - A raw snapshot_id
Falls back to the reduced PLY, then to the inline snapshot geometry (preview meshes), when no original PLY is available. Point clouds prefer the full PLY, then the inline preview. An element that has only an authored shape (a box or prism, no scan) is built from its parameters.
Converts to collection of generic geometry
